[previewyoutube=rqR7U8_rtm8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone! If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist《工廈 Warehouse》on Steam — your support is everything for this solo indie horror journey through the underbelly of Hong Kong’s industrial buildings 🖤

This week, I’ve designed the transition level between Level 2 and Level 3:
The staircase.

In this video, you’ll see how the layout started as a basic prototype, and then transformed with textures, lighting, and post-process effects.

🕳️ Though this stairwell is a shorter level and didn’t take as long to finish, the atmosphere is key — and just like in real-life industrial buildings in Hong Kong, some corners of these staircases are so dark you don’t know what's in there.

These places are where urban legends are born, and ghost stories feel a little too believable 👻

🔜 Next devlog: I’ll be diving into Level 3 — a brand new floor in the building, featuring completely different layouts, interactions, puzzles… and of course, a new wave of jumpscares. It’s gonna get weird.

Stay tuned!

IHey everyone! Quick update on the development of《工廈 Warehouse》— and a warm welcome to anyone new landing on this page.

The final two units for this level are now fully blocked out:

One is a small office, the kind you’d often find tucked inside an old Hong Kong industrial building. These re-used spaces are everywhere — people set up tiny businesses in them because of the cheaper rent.

The other is a large server room, filled with humming machines and tight aisles. It’s the kind of place you’re not sure anyone really has permission to be in...

These are now visually complete and fully explorable in-game. As always, I’m building this world with strong Hong Kong industrial vibes in mind —  just unsettling enough to keep you looking over your shoulder.

notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A quick reminder: if you haven't already, please wishlist《工廈 Warehouse》on Steam — it really helps a lot for a solo indie developer like me!

Wishlist here!
🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656990/_Warehouse/]Warehouse 工廈[/url]

This week’s update:

[previewyoutube=zUPQw5lxZMU;full][/previewyoutube]

I've finished blocking out two new units for Level 2 — office-style rooms hidden inside the industrial building.
In real-life Hong Kong, many old factory spaces are turned into messy, eclectic offices because of cheaper rent. I wanted to capture that atmosphere: worn-out desks, scattered paperwork, and a lingering feeling that the people here left... but not everything did.

You’ll notice three of the office rooms share similar, slightly varied decorations — a glimpse into the strange normalcy that existed before everything fell apart.

Only two more units left to decorate for this level.
After that, I’ll start building out the overall level flow and gameplay structure!

notes.title: Now Sharing Devlogs on Steam – Follow the Journey!
notes.content:
📢 Development update from now on:
I’ll be posting regular devlogs right here on Steam! 

🧟‍♂️ Wishlist Warehouse 工廈 to stay updated and help indie horror thrive:
🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656990/_Warehouse/]Warehouse 工廈[/url]

The intro level is DONE—now it’s time to step inside. The protagonist has finally arrived at Floor 5, but what’s lurking in the dimly lit hallways? 🏢🔦

[previewyoutube=ON7a2I_LyNY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hong Kong industrial buildings are a maze of possibilities—offices, storage units, server rooms, logistics hubs. But this one? Feels... different. Empty. Too quiet. Like something is just out of sight, waiting.

🚧 What's New This Week?
The world’s getting bigger — and we’re diving deeper into the haunted mess that is the second floor.

Two new storage areas—filled with cardboard, cabinets, and the second area with oddly placed cribs—are now fully blocked out and radiate the right eerie vibe.

🧭 What’s Next?
Up next, I’ll be working on the remaining half of the second floor, fleshing out the final sections before circling back to polish the flow and scares. Still debating how surreal to go — but let’s just say reality will start bending a lot more from here on out.
